title: I2C timeouts with internal pull-ups disabled
serial_logs:
E (1210) bme280: read chip id failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (2210) bme280: read chip id failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (3210) bme280: read chip id failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
user_question: Bare BME280 chip on a breadboard, no breakout board. SDA/SCL are wired directly.

reference_context.title: I2C-bus Specification UM10204 (NXP)
reference_context.snippet: Both SDA and SCL are bidirectional lines, connected to a positive supply voltage via a current-source or pull-up resistor. When the bus is free, both lines are HIGH. The output stages of devices connected to the bus must have an open-drain or open-collector to perform the wired-AND function.

expected.root_cause: The I2C lines have no pull-up resistors (internal pull-ups disabled and none on the bare chip), so the open-drain bus never returns high and transactions time out.
expected.fix: Add external pull-ups (about 4.7 kΩ to 3.3 V) on SDA and SCL; enabling the weak internal pull-ups is only a stopgap.
